THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Oatmeal Creme Pie Cookie Creami

Crumbl’s Oatmeal Creme Pie Cookie, Creami-style (9.5/10): a vanilla Nurri 2% and whey isolate base respun with half a Voortman Zero Sugar Oatmeal Cookie and 1 tbsp Jet-Puffed Marshmallow Creme, topped with the other half cookie. About 330 calories and 35g protein for the entire finished pint.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME24 hr freeze + 5 min rest + spin
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~330 cal | ~35g protein

Ingredients

BASE

  • 1 cup (240ml) Nurri plain 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 1/2 labelled serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate
  • 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum, leveled
  • Pinch of salt
  • 1 tsp vanilla

MIX-IN

  • 1/2 Voortman Zero Sugar Oatmeal Cookie
  • 1 tbsp Jet-Puffed Marshmallow Creme

TOPPING

  • Remaining 1/2 of the same Voortman Zero Sugar Oatmeal Cookie (1 whole cookie total)

Allergens: dairy, wheat, gluten.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND & FREEZE BASE. Blend 1 cup Nurri plain 2% milk, 1/2 serving unflavored whey isolate, 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener, 1/8 tsp leveled guar gum, a pinch of salt, and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth. Freeze upright and level for 24 hours.
  2. 2.SPLIT THE COOKIE. Break 1 Voortman Zero Sugar Oatmeal Cookie in half—half goes into the Respin with the marshmallow creme, and the other half goes on top.
  3. 3.SPIN & ADD MIX-INS. Rest the pint 5 minutes on the counter and process on Regular Ice Cream. Add half the oatmeal cookie and 1 tbsp Jet-Puffed Marshmallow Creme to the already-spun base.
  4. 4.RESPIN & TOP. Respin without adding liquid, then serve and crumble the remaining half cookie on top.

Storage and reheating

Store: Freeze the unspun base upright and level for up to 1 week. Add the oatmeal cookie, marshmallow creme, and cookie topping when spinning to serve.

Reheat: Do not heat the pint.

Lasts: Unspun frozen pint keeps 1 week; enjoy immediately after Respin and topping.

Estimated nutrition

~330 cal | ~35g protein per 1 whole finished Creami pint (with 1 cookie + 1 tbsp marshmallow creme).

Estimated 325.5 calories / 35g protein, rounded to ≈330 calories / 35g protein for the complete finished pint. Breakdown: 1 cup Nurri plain 2% milk (150 cal, 20g protein) + 1/2 serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate (60 cal, 14g protein) + 1 whole Voortman Zero Sugar Oatmeal Cookie split between mix-in and topping (80 cal, 1g protein) + 1 tbsp Jet-Puffed Marshmallow Creme (22.5 cal, 0g protein; half of a 45-cal / 2-tbsp serving) + 1 tsp vanilla (12 cal standard extract allowance) + sweetener/guar/salt (1 cal). Recreates the flavor of Crumbl’s Oatmeal Creme Pie Cookie; a Crumbl cookie is not an ingredient.
